blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An old food company with Vice President Sara Duterte as one of the shareholders used to have a fictitious president, former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV claimed on Friday. In his press briefing in San Juan City, Trillanes said that Duterte listed two business interests in her 2025 Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) — Metro City Chow Foods Corp. which used to be City Hall King Chow Foods Corp.; and GenCorp Industries Inc., which was formerly known as Timesquare Bee Foods Corp.
